summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; client_id from login then extra.client_id; client_secret from password then extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type to oauth and env-var references for both secrets). Registered it directly after the token mapping in profile_mappings, and added it to the exports in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claims, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, profile-arg override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run, per instructions. No commits made.
